definition: A series of 2D optical confocal images taken at sequential focal planes along the vertical axis to reconstruct a 3D volume.
manuscriptExample: Confocal Z-stack imaging confirmed intracellular internalization of fluorescently labeled nanoparticles.
conferenceExample: The reviewer commended the inclusion of maximum intensity projection renderings generated from 40-micron Z-stacks.

definition: An electrophoretic technique for detecting hydrolytic enzyme activity using substrate-impregnated gels.
manuscriptExample: Gelatin zymography revealed elevated MMP-2 and MMP-9 enzymatic cleavage in conditioned media.
conferenceExample: Reviewer 1 requested gel zymography quantification alongside Western blotting to verify protease secretion.
